CORAM : SIDDHESHWAR S. THOMBRE, J.
 DATE : 6th JANUARY, 2026  P.C.:-
1.
Heard learned Advocates for the respective parties.

2. By the present petition, the Petitioners are assailing the order dated 31.03.2011 passed by the learned Joint Civil Judge, Senior Division, Kandhar, District Nanded in L.A.R. No.219 of 2009,
whereby reference filed by the Petitioners for enhancement of compensation was partly allowed.

3. Considering the nature of the challenge and the reliefs sought in the petition, the Petitioners have an efficacious alternative remedy of filing an appeal under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894.
Hence, the petition deserves to be disposed of on that ground.
4. Petitioners are at liberty to file appeal under Section 54 of 2 of 2 951-WP.6762.2017 the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
5. In the event the Petitioners file an appeal, they shall not be entitled to claim any interest for the period from the date of filing of the present petition till the date of filing of the appeal.

6. Needless to mention that the time spent in prosecuting the present petition shall be taken into consideration while deciding the application for condonation of delay, if the Petitioners file an Sangram Bhagwanrao Kadam And Another vs The State Of Maharashtra And Others on 6 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188697477/
1 appeal.
7.
